findings.message: GSAP tweens overlap on "#seal" for y between 1.55s and 1.95s.
findings.fixHint: Shorten the earlier tween, move the later tween, or add `overwrite: "auto"`.

findings.message: 2 tl.fromTo() calls target "#seal" with no stable baseline. The last-authored fromTo "from" values become the element's resting state for any seek before the first tween actually runs, because GSAP applies fromTo from-values at authoring time (immediateRender), not at tween position.
findings.fixHint: Add `immediateRender: false` to every fromTo except the earliest-positioned one (at 1.05s), so pre-first-tween seeks keep its "from" values. A hiding `tl.set(..., 0)` baseline trips gsap_timeline_set_initial_hide, and a `gsap.set` authored before the fromTo calls is overwritten by them.

findings.fixHint: Add `immediateRender: false` to every fromTo except the earliest-positioned one (at 0s), so pre-first-tween seeks keep its "from" values. findings.message: GSAP tween on "#sub" uses motion that snaps to integer device pixels: letterSpacing. Layout and text-reflow properties snap during browser layout; roundProps rounds the tween value. Slow motion or an ease-out tail then stutters under the seek-by-frame capture engine. Animate transforms (x/y/scale/opacity) instead.
findings.fixHint: do not animate letterSpacing (they reflow text and snap glyph positions): for letterSpacing, split the text into per-character elements and animate each glyph's x (the spread), since uniform scale is NOT equivalent, or hold the final value statically. Transforms interpolate sub-pixel and stay smooth at any speed.

findings.message: <div id="bg"> is a timeline element that contains nested <div id="cloud-v">. The timeline shows one row per top-level element, and the root composition is built only from sub-compositions.
findings.fixHint: Move <div id="bg"> and its contents into a sub-composition file and mount it with data-composition-src.
